Tutiyubaye ngo tugenze impwemu ko zoba ari iziva ku Mana turashobora gusanga twifatanije n'impwemu za antikristo, tugashigikira ibikorwa vy'umwiza. Akageresho canke igipimo co kudufasha kumenya impwemu za antikristo canke abigisha b'ibinyoma tugasanga muri 1 Yohana 4 : 2 - 3. Twarangiri ku majambo yo guhanura abana b'Imana ngo bakundane ariko atari rwa rukundo rwo mw'isi rujanye n'ivy'ukwubakana canke ubusambanyi canke ubundi bucuti, oya n'urukundo rw'Imana rutuma abayizera bose bababarana bakumva ko barumwe. Uwundafise urukundo rwo gukunda bene data turabona ivyiwe mu ncamake muri 1 Yohana 4 : 8 ngo uwudakundana ntazi Imana kuko Imana ari urukundo.

teaching.description: Mu kiganiro giheruka twaciye hirya no hino ijambo rivuga yuko Umwami Yesu Kristo ariwe bugingo. Uwumwizera akmwakira nk'Umukiza aba yakiriye ubwo bugingo budashira. Twarumvise yuko hari abihenda ngo n'abana b'Imana kubera ko bari mw'ishengero kandi bahafise ibikorwa, ariko twibuke yuko uwo wese atarizera Umwami Yesu ngo amwakire mu bugingo bwiwe aba ataracika umwana w'Imana. Twarangirije k'umurongo 1 Yohana 5 : 12 ,haravuga ngo: Uwufise Umwana wayo niwe afise ubwo bugingo, uwudafise Umwana w"Imana ntafise ubwo bugingo.
